ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Bones
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
BONES_LEAN_PORT_BUILD_TREELESS_WORLD: bone as building stock on a treeless world. A lean port of "Rim of Madness - Bones" (sihv.rombonesPort, MIT, Copyright (c) 2018 Rim of Madness Team), with our art and numbers. Composed into RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes (mandrake.rm.biomes) as an engine entry.
Ships: 1. RM_Bones, a Woody stuff: walls, doors, furniture and anything wood-stuffed can be built of bone. 2. RM_BoneAmount, a pawn stat (50 per unit of body size; the megafauna yield patches scale it with body size squared). Butchering a fleshy, non-insect corpse that yields more than one meat also yields RoundRandom(RM_BoneAmount x multiplier x butcher efficiency) bones. 3. RM_BoneFloor, a bone-tile floor. 4. Save back-compat (RM_DefAliasDef): the donor's BoneItem, BoneChina, Bonecrete and BonePlastic load as RM_Bones and its five floors as RM_BoneFloor, so the ancient bone-china walls and doors keep loading. 5. Mod Settings: butcher bones on/off, bone yield multiplier. Left out on purpose: the donor's chemfuel, calcium-polymer and plasteel routes, marrow and gelatin, the throne, the masks and the bow restuffing.
